t: Bosch Expert PowerChange Plus holesaw arbor with 85mm pilot drill for fast accessory changes. The holesaw adaptor features a quick release keyless system offering easy plug ejection without the need for screws or bolts. Reinforced shank offers improved tolerances and greater accuracy. Compatible with all corded and cordless drill drivers, including SDS chucks, it accepts Bosch Progressor and Bosch Carbide holesaws from 14–210mm in diameter. Includes a HSS-G 1/4" pilot drill bit that is suitable for wood, metal and plastic.
b: Attaches to PowerChange Plus Arbor Holesaws
